note: Village of Stapleton municipal park on the north edge of town along NE Hwy 92: camping, restrooms and showers (closed for the winter), tennis and sand volleyball courts, playground, covered shelter. Camper reviews and directories (not the village) describe ~6 grass/gravel drive-in sites with shared 20/30-amp electric and water posts, a dump station and a self-pay envelope (~$10-15 a night, donation); reviewers report rigs to ~36 ft. --Claude
